entities.name: Luigi Oreglia di Santo Stefano
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Luigi Oreglia di Santo Stefano was a cardinal of the Catholic Church in the late nineteenth century. He was Bishop of Ostia e Velletri and Dean of the Sacred College of Cardinals from 1896 until his death.
